rules.message: Belongs to a socially and economically disadvantaged section of society (criteria as per the Mission Shakti Guidelines)
For the first living child, or for the second living child only if the second child is a girl

benefits.text: ₹5,000 for the first living child, in two instalments, paid directly to the bank or post office account (DBT).
₹6,000 for the second living child if the child is a girl, in one instalment after birth.
For the first child, the remaining cash incentive under Janani Suraksha Yojana after institutional delivery, so that on average a woman gets ₹6,000.

required_documents.name: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card - the main verification tool
Bank account or post office account for direct transfer
Aadhaar, as required by the Ministry's notifications under section 7 of the Aadhaar Act

how_to_apply.text: Register at an Anganwadi centre or an approved government health facility, or through online self-registration.
First child, first instalment: on registration of pregnancy and at least one ante-natal check-up within six months from the last menstrual period.
Second child (girl): the birth must be registered under the scheme and the child must have received all due vaccines up to 14 weeks of age.

flags.detail: The list of criteria for 'socially and economically disadvantaged sections' (Mission Shakti Guidelines, e.g. SC/ST, disability, income limits) was not retrieved from an official document (the FAQ PDF failed a certificate check), so it is a manual check and category/income are not checked automatically.

notes: The Rules allow the Central Government to change the amounts from time to time (rule 8); amounts here are as of the 2022 Rules and the current Ministry page.
